summary.overview: The project has strong static quality gates and a comprehensive root instruction file, but the core chat orchestration path lacks test and diagnostic coverage, CI test scope excludes two packages, and session evidence is too sparse to validate loop effectiveness.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: A dense, frequently maintained root AGENTS.md routes to commands, architecture, and constraints, but the two hottest source roots lack module-local instruction files.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Broad command surface with devcontainer and pnpm workspace; no doctor or health-check command validates the local environment before work begins.

findings.title: Chat turn orchestrator has no test and no server-side logging
findings.reason: handle-chat-turn.ts wires the entire streaming lifecycle (runtime creation, prompt execution, event subscription, abort handling, mirror sync) in 195 lines. Zero test files import it and zero log statements exist inside runChatTurn. When runtime creation or session prompt fails, the error is caught and emitted as a client stream event, but no server-side structured record enables post-hoc diagnosis. Consequence: production turn failures are invisible to operators and regressions in the orchestration path cannot be caught before merge. Owner: apps/web/src/lib/pi/. Uncertainty: integration behavior may be partially exercised by E2E smoke, but that path is not verified.
expectedOutput: A unit test exercising the handle-chat-turn error path with attributable diagnostics
Server-side structured log statements inside runChatTurn with requestId correlation
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a focused unit test for handle-chat-turn.ts covering the error path (runtime creation failure, prompt rejection) and add request-scoped pino log statements inside runChatTurn for lifecycle start, error, and teardown.

## Validation

- Run pnpm --filter web test and confirm the new test passes
- Confirm structured log output includes requestId correlation

findings.title: CI test job excludes hax-design and pi-protocol packages
findings.reason: The CI test step runs pnpm --filter web test only. packages/hax-design has 7 test files and packages/pi-protocol has a vitest config with test script; neither is exercised on PRs. hax-design is the highest-scored core candidate (149 source files, 35 commits in 180 days). Consequence: regressions in the UI component library and wire-protocol package reach main undetected. Owner: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Uncertainty: root pnpm test via turbo may run these locally, but CI does not invoke it.
expectedOutput: CI test step exercises hax-design and pi-protocol test suites on every PR
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Change the CI test step from pnpm --filter web test to pnpm test (turbo-orchestrated across all workspaces) or add explicit --filter hax-design --filter pi-protocol filters.

## Validation

- Confirm CI workflow runs tests for all three packages
- Run pnpm test locally and verify hax-design and pi-protocol tests execute

findings.title: Two largest source roots lack module-local agent instructions
findings.reason: apps/web (199 source files, 173 commits) and packages/hax-design (149 files, 35 commits) have no nested AGENTS.md. Nested instruction coverage is 1% (only agent-workspace/, 3 files). An agent entering either root must parse the 162-line monolithic root document to locate relevant boundaries, increasing context-reach latency and mis-route risk for the hottest files. Owner: repository root. Uncertainty: the root document may be sufficient for experienced maintainers; the gap is agent-specific.
expectedOutput: Module-local instruction files for apps/web and packages/hax-design that route agents to the correct boundaries and checks
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a concise apps/web/AGENTS.md covering the lib/ module boundaries, route conventions, and test commands. Add a packages/hax-design/AGENTS.md covering the registry structure, import conventions, and component test commands.

## Validation

- Run pnpm validate-agents-md
- Confirm nested instruction count increases from 1 to 3

findings.title: Three exact Memory-title collisions await governance review
findings.reason: The asset-integrity scan found 3 exact same-scope title collision groups (Fleet_Pi_Project_Introduction x2, Fleet_Pi_Tech_Stack x2, Prettier_+_Tailwind_Plugin_Configuration x2) and 1 near-similarity pair (Turbo-Based / Turbo-powered, 81%). Title collisions prove metadata duplication only, not duplicate body content or retrieval harm, but they create ambiguity for retrieval routing. Owner: Qoder project Memory governance. Uncertainty: bodies were not read; conflict or staleness is unconfirmed.
expectedOutput: Exact title collisions resolved through verified merge or deletion
Near-similarity pair dispositioned as merged or intentionally distinct
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Review the 3 exact Memory-title collision groups using SearchMemory to inspect their bodies. Merge or delete confirmed duplicates, keeping the most complete entry. Review the near-similarity pair for merge eligibility.

## Validation

- Re-run asset-baseline integrity and confirm exactCollisionGroups drops to 0
- Confirm no retrieval regression by searching affected topics

findings.title: Tech-debt CI gate cannot block a merge
findings.reason: The tech-debt CI job sets continue-on-error: true. The scan uploads a report artifact but never fails the workflow, so accumulating debt markers (TODO, FIXME, HACK) are visible but mechanically unenforced. Owner: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Uncertainty: this may be intentional to avoid blocking on legacy markers; the project tracks debt separately in tech-debt-report.json.
expectedOutput: Tech-debt gate enforces a net-new threshold while preserving baseline tolerance
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Evaluate whether the tech-debt gate should enforce a threshold. If yes, remove continue-on-error and add a maximum-marker threshold that fails the job only on net-new debt above baseline.

## Validation

- Confirm the gate fails on a test branch with net-new debt markers above baseline
- Confirm existing baseline markers do not block current PRs
